channel.title: World
channel.description: The Washington Post World section provides information and analysis of breaking world news stories. In addition to our world news and video, Post World News offers discussions and blogs on major international news and economic issues.

item.title: She’s a Trump acolyte. He’s a ‘gringo Sandinista.’ Meet the Harps.
item.dc:creator: Terrence McCoy
item.description: Trump aide Natalie Harp is estranged from her brother, Preston, who has used social media and recent interviews to criticize her and highlight his own left-wing politics.

item.title: Israel probes killing of Hind Rajab, Gaza child who called for help
item.dc:creator: Sammy Westfall, Meg Kelly, Lior Soroka, Karen DeYoung
item.description: An Israeli fact-finding mission declined to refer some other “exceptional” cases, including the killing of World Central Kitchen aid workers, to military prosecutors.
